tagline.en_US: The maintained jlesage MakeMKV image with persistent settings, shared input/output storage and optional native optical-drive passthrough.

description.en_US: MakeMKV is a video format converter that extracts video clips from proprietary and encrypted discs into MKV files. It preserves original video and audio tracks, chapters, and metadata without re-encoding or compressing the content. The tool is designed to digitize DVD and Blu-ray media while maintaining the exact original quality of the source disc.
